message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have a built‑in function for calculating nutrient requirements. The only function available to me is `calculate_water_needs`, which estimates how much water a plant needs each week.

If you’d like, I can give you a general idea of how to estimate nutrient needs for a cactus in Arizona during summer:

| Nutrient | Typical Weekly Requirement (approx.) |
|----------|---------------------------------------|
| Nitrogen (N) | 0.5–1 g per plant |
| Phosphorus (P) | 0.2–0.4 g per plant |
| Potassium (K) | 0.8–1.5 g per plant |

These values are very rough and depend on factors such as soil fertility, plant size, and local climate. For precise dosing, it’s best to use a soil test kit or consult a local horticultural extension service.
